description: Prompt-to-build eval suite for Otter. Each scenario is a real prompt run against a live stack and scored on whether it produced a reachable app.

scenarios.prompt: Build a single-page static landing site for a coffee shop with a hero section, an opening-hours table, and a contact form that posts nowhere. Serve it with nginx in Docker.
Build a FastAPI service with a /health endpoint returning {"status":"ok"} and a /quote endpoint returning a random quote as JSON. Run it in Docker on port 8000.
Build an Express API in TypeScript with in-memory CRUD for a 'task' resource (create, list, get, update, delete), input validation, and a /health endpoint. Containerise it and run it.
Build a React + Vite dashboard with three stat cards and a sortable table of mock sales data. Style it cleanly with CSS. Build it for production and serve the static output from Docker.
Build a Go REST API backed by PostgreSQL with a migration for a 'notes' table and endpoints to create and list notes. Use docker compose so the database starts alongside the API.
Make me something that tracks stuff.
scenarios.notes: Deliberately underspecified. Measures whether the agent picks a reasonable interpretation and still ships something running, rather than stalling or asking.
